{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify deduplication
print(f"After deduplication: {len(df_dedup)} rows, {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()} unique patients")

# Compute response rates by arm
treatment_prop = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_prop = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
diff = treatment_prop - control_prop

print(f"Treatment response rate: {treatment_prop}")
print(f"Control response rate: {control_prop}")
print(f"Difference (treatment - control): {diff}")

# Check confounding: arm vs severity
confound = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'])
print(f"Cross-tab: arm vs severity\n{confound}")

# Compute response rate by severity
response_by_severity = df_dedup.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean()
print(f"Response rate by severity:\n{response_by_severity}")"}
